2607.21279.title: A Unified Moral-Value Dataset for Instruction Tuning
2607.21279.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have developed rapidly and become valuable tools in everyday life. However, how to align LLMs to a particular set of human values is still an open problem. Recent studies show that instruction tuning has strong potential for zero-shot tasks and may serve as an effective approach to addressing value alignment. Nevertheless, although many datasets for instruction tuning already exist, they are not specifically designed around moral scenarios and behaviors. We construct a unified moral-value dataset that can be directly used for instruction tuning. This dataset is built upon existing moral-value datasets by merging them into a unified corpus and converting them into an instruction-response format. We show that training on a mixed dataset combining general task datasets with our dataset preserves general-task performance, and we report preliminary observations on how the mixing ratio affects value-oriented task performance. Our work provides a moral-value dataset for instruction tuning and offers a useful resource for further alignment research. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/teohzzh/value-for-instruction-tuning.
2607.21279.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）迅速發展，並成為日常生活中有價值的工具。<lb/>然而，如何將LLMs與特定的人類價值觀對齊仍然是一個未解決的問題。<lb/>最近的研究顯示，指令調整在零樣本任務中具有強大的潛力，並可能作為解決價值對齊的有效方法。<lb/>儘管許多指令調整的數據集已經存在，但它們並不是專門設計用於道德情境和行為的。<lb/>我們構建了一個統一的道德價值數據集，可以直接用於指令調整。<lb/>這個數據集是基於現有的道德價值數據集，通過將它們合併成一個統一的語料庫並轉換為指令-回應格式來構建的。<lb/>我們顯示，使用結合一般任務數據集與我們的數據集的混合數據集進行訓練，可以保留一般任務的表現，並報告了混合比例如何影響以價值為導向的任務表現的初步觀察。<lb/>我們的工作提供了一個用於指令調整的道德價值數據集，並為進一步的對齊研究提供了一個有用的資源。<lb/>該數據集可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/teohzzh/value-for-instruction-tuning 獲得。
